subject: Discovery recap & bake-off scope for FinTechCo evaluation
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@fintechco.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-09-12T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Discovery recap & proposed bake-off scope

Hi Jordan — thanks again for the intro call today. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we keep momentum. Re-stating what we heard and what we plan to deliver for the evaluation.

Summary of pain points you shared:
- Latency spikes on your current in-house endpoint under bursty traffic (esp. peak close-of-day batch jobs).
- Cost unpredictability for high QPS embedding and reranking workloads.
- Need for strong auditability and VPC isolation for regulated customers.
- Desire to compare output quality and determinism vs your existing vLLM setup and our cloud/TGI alternatives.

Success criteria you articulated (weighting noted where Jordan indicated preference):
1) Latency & Stability (primary, 50%): p95/p99 under test load; deterministic tail behavior across 24h run.
2) Cost per 1M tokens + embedding unit economics (secondary, 30%).
3) Functional parity / quality (20%): top-k accuracy on retrieval/rerank tasks, embedding cosine drift < 0.02 vs your internal baseline.
4) Compliance checks: VPC connectivity, audit log retention, and role-based access.

Proposed bake-off arms and benchmarks:
- Arm A: Redwood Hosted (production config, standard quantization).
- Arm B: Redwood Dedicated (reserved capacity with autoscaling knob).
- Arm C: Baselines you asked to include: vLLM (on your infra) and TGI cloud endpoints.

Benchmarks to run:
- Gen latency: 1k prompts at 512-token avg, measure p50/p95/p99 and CPU/GPU utilization.
- Throughput: sustained QPS for 30m windows at concurrency points you care about (10/50/200).
- Embeddings: 5k pairwise similarity checks, report mean cosine and stddev vs your gold set.
- Rerank: end-to-end latency for 10-choice rerank scenarios and top-1 accuracy delta.

Acceptance thresholds (draft):
- p99 latency for 512-token generation under target concurrency <= 900ms for production arm.
- Throughput: >= 30 req/s sustained at 512 tokens for Dedicated arm while meeting p95 SLA.
- Embedding cosine drift <= 0.02 and recall (R@10) within 2% of baseline.
- Compliance: VPC peering + audit logs delivered within the trial window.

Data / access we need from FinTechCo:
- A 500-1k sample prompt set and a 5k embedding gold set (S3 link is fine).
- Short-lived service account or test API keys for the vLLM/TGI comparators if you want Redwood to run the baseline comparisons.
- Procurement contact for SOC2 / SOW discussions.

Suggested timeline:
- Week 0 (this week): agree on dataset and acceptance criteria; sign mutual NDA if needed.
- Week 1: Redwood prepares bake-off harness and seeds runs; kickoff call to confirm configurations.
- Week 2: Run the three arms and deliver preliminary report.
- Week 3: Final results, cost modeling, and rollout recommendations.

Action items (owners):
- Jordan / FinTechCo: Share S3 link & procurement contact (Jordan) — due 2025-09-15.
- Redwood (Aisha + Vivek): Deliver bake-off plan and runbook; estimate cost and scheduling — send by 2025-09-14.
- Laura: Escalate reserved capacity quote if they request Dedicated for the trial.

Attachments: I will attach a short bake-off plan and a data manifest template for your review.

Thanks — happy to tighten any of the metrics above. If you agree, I can lock in a kickoff slot on Tuesday 2025-09-16 at 10:00 PT.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0132
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-bakeoff-plan-v1.pdf (application/pdf, 240KB)

From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@fintechco.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
Cc: FinTechCo Procurement <procurement@fintechco.com>
Date: 2025-09-13T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap & bake-off scope for FinTechCo evaluation

Thanks Aisha — this is great and captures the ask. A few clarifications from my side:

1) Priority order confirmed: latency/determinism first, cost second, then quality. If latency regresses on any arm we consider it a fail.
2) We prefer you run the vLLM and TGI baselines if possible — saves our infra cycles. We can provide short-lived credentials.
3) Dataset: https://s3.fintechco.com/test-data/fintech-prompt-set-v1 (read-only is fine). The embedding gold set is in the same bucket under embeddings/goldset-v1.csv.
4) Timeline: procurement is slow; procurement contact is Priya Das (procurement@fintechco.com) — they will need a short SOW and pricing estimate before granting extended access.

We can do kickoff Tue 2025-09-16 at 10:00 PT — confirm and send calendar invite.

Jordan
Senior PM, Search & Recommendations
FinTechCo

On Fri, Sep 12, 2025 at 2:03 PM Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Jordan — thanks again for the intro call today. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we keep momentum...

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-09-14T11:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap & bake-off scope for FinTechCo evaluation (internal)

Aisha — looping in some technical notes based on the dataset link Jordan provided. I drafted a short execution plan and attached the PDF. High-level notes:

- We can run three arms as requested. For parity, I recommend we test Llama-2-13b-chat and Mistral-Instruct equivalents as the model family baselines across vLLM/TGI and Redwood.
- Include quantized int8 and fp16 runs to show cost/latency tradeoffs. We should keep the same prompt formatting and temperature seeds for determinism.
- For embedded rerank tests, we'll use your goldset and compute R@1/R@5 and average embedding cosine.
- I will provision a small Dedicated pool (2xA100 equiv) for the trial if procurement approves; otherwise run Dedicated-sim on our staging infra and label accordingly.

Deliverables I will produce by 2025-09-14: bake-off harness config, runbook, and estimated token cost model for each arm.

Attachments: redwood-bakeoff-plan-v1.pdf (contains run commands and config).

Vivek
Staff Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
